visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The screen is divided into two vertical panels showing a mobile MOBA game interface. On the left, Traditional Chinese UI is visible, and on the right, Vietnamese UI. A female character with long white hair and a red-themed outfit moves swiftly across a green arena floor. She leaves behind bright red energy trails and strikes at a stationary armored enemy. (2) The character performs a specialized ability that summons large, translucent purple-and-black dragon-like heads from beneath the ground. A dark circular void forms around her on the ground. Numerical indicators like '32' and '31' appear over her head, tracking cooldowns. The UI buttons on the bottom right glow as they are being triggered. (3) The scene transitions into a repeated sequence of high-speed dashes and magical effects. The background consists of a stylized stone pathway and green grassy patches typical of a fantasy battleground. A static text overlay at the top center credits a source in Traditional Chinese text over a black bar.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched female voice speaks a clear phrase in Japanese with a confident and melodic intonation. Underneath the voice, high-frequency 'whooshing' sound effects represent the character's rapid physical movements and dashes. A cinematic orchestral background music track features a steady percussive beat and driving string melodies. (2) A sharp, metallic 'clinking' sound effect is triggered as a skill is activated, followed by a resonant magical explosion sound with broad spectral bandwidth. The female speaker emits a short, energetic grunt of effort. The background music maintains a constant intensity, bridging the two distinct sound effect triggers. (3) The sequence loops, repeating the combination of the Japanese vocal line and the layered sound design. Various digital UI clicks and shimmering magical textures are heard in rapid succession. The overall mix is dense, with sharp transient sound effects clearly prioritized in the master channel over the orchestral background track.
